# A commodity declaration, and a line the parser cannot read.
#
# The parser records a structural error and carries on building directives, so
# a file like this still yields a commodity and an account — and the
# `--include-business-objects` pass wrote them into the book without ever
# asking whether the parse had failed, while the transaction pass returned on
# the same errors having done nothing. The run then reported `Errors: 1` and
# `✓ Changes saved`, and only on that path: the same file without the flag
# wrote nothing at all. One file, two answers, decided by a flag.
#
# The file carries no business objects on purpose. One with an invoice in it
# was already saved by a different arm of the same condition, so the shape
# that shows this is the one where the commodity is all there is.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the file, and no book — with
# the flag and without it.
2026-01-01 commodity QQD
	mnemonic: "QQD"
	fullname: "Q Fund"
	namespace: "FUND"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		this line is indented under nothing and states nothing
